Succeed socially is, in it's own words, a site for getting from below average in social skills to average in social skills. The articles are extremely comprehensive and incredibly well structured. The articles explain precisely why a particular behavior or belief is a problem or the situations in which you will need a particular skill. Instead of proposing a single solution, it tries to list a wide variety of approaches.

If you are completely clueless when it comes to social skills, the comprehensiveness is a great advantage, as it will allow you to understand how most people understand the situation and consider almost too obvious to state. It is also very useful if you are struggling with a particular area as some of the articles can almost be used as checklists of what methods to try.

If you already have a decent understanding of social skills, you may want to be selective in the articles you read simply because of the length of the content and the fact that the articles are optimised for comprehensiveness, as opposed to novelness.
